textos.S:
Read the text and answer the questions.

Sara's first job

Last summer, Sara worked at a small bookshop in her town. At first she was nervous because she had to talk to many customers, and she was not sure she could remember where every book was. Her manager, Mr. Díaz, gave her a map of the shop and told her to ask questions whenever she needed help.

After two weeks, Sara knew the shop so well that she started recommending books to customers. By the end of the summer, she had saved enough money to buy a new laptop for university, and she had discovered that she wants to study literature.

preguntas.enunciado: Where can you see this notice?
preguntas.retro: «Seatbelt» es el cinturón de seguridad: el aviso es típico de un avión.

preguntas.contexto: NO FOOD OR DRINKS NEAR THE COMPUTERS
preguntas.enunciado: Where can you see this notice?
preguntas.retro: El aviso prohíbe comida y bebidas cerca de los computadores.

preguntas.enunciado: What does this notice mean?

opciones.texto: There are no more tickets for the concert.
The tickets are on sale today.

preguntas.retro: «Sold out» significa agotado.

preguntas.enunciado: You use this to cut paper. It has two blades. What is it? Write one word.
preguntas.retro: Scissors = tijeras.

preguntas.enunciado: Which word matches this definition? «A person who travels to visit places for pleasure.»

opciones.retro: Un piloto viaja por trabajo, no por placer.

preguntas.retro: Tourist = turista.

preguntas.enunciado: Complete the sentence: «I'm really ____. I haven't eaten anything since breakfast.»

opciones.retro: Thirsty = con sed; la frase habla de comer.

preguntas.retro: Hungry = con hambre.

preguntas.enunciado: This notice means that any visitor can enter this area.
preguntas.retro: «Staff only» significa solo personal autorizado: los visitantes no pueden entrar.

preguntas.enunciado: Complete the sentence: «She ____ to school every day.»

opciones.retro: Con she/he/it en presente simple el verbo lleva -s o -es.

preguntas.retro: Presente simple, tercera persona del singular: she goes.

preguntas.enunciado: Complete the sentence: «Yesterday we ____ a great movie.»
preguntas.retro: «Yesterday» indica pasado: se usa el pasado simple (watched).

preguntas.enunciado: Complete the sentence: «If it rains tomorrow, we ____ at home.»
preguntas.retro: Primer condicional: if + presente, will + verbo.

preguntas.enunciado: Complete the sentence: «This is the ____ book I have ever read.»

opciones.retro: Better es comparativo; aquí se necesita el superlativo.

preguntas.retro: Superlativo de good: the best.

preguntas.enunciado: Choose the best answer. A: «Have you finished your homework?» B: «____»

opciones.texto: Not yet. I'll do it after dinner.

preguntas.retro: «Not yet» (todavía no) responde de forma coherente a «Have you finished…?».

preguntas.enunciado: Which sentences are grammatically correct? Select all the correct answers.

opciones.texto: There are three students in the room.

preguntas.retro: Concordancia sujeto-verbo: she doesn't, they were.

preguntas.enunciado: Complete the sentence: «I have lived in Cartagena ____ 2019.»

opciones.retro: For se usa con períodos de tiempo (for five years).

preguntas.retro: Since + punto de inicio en el tiempo (since 2019).

preguntas.enunciado: Where did Sara work last summer?
preguntas.retro: «Sara worked at a small bookshop in her town».

preguntas.enunciado: Why was Sara nervous at first?

opciones.texto: Because she had to talk to many customers and remember where the books were.
Because her manager was angry with her.
Because the shop was very big and dark.

preguntas.retro: El primer párrafo explica sus dos preocupaciones.

preguntas.enunciado: What did Mr. Díaz do to help Sara?

opciones.texto: He gave her a map of the shop.
He did her work for her.

preguntas.retro: «Mr. Díaz gave her a map of the shop and told her to ask questions».

preguntas.enunciado: What can we infer about Sara at the end of the summer?

opciones.texto: She felt more confident and found a career she is interested in.
She wants to work at the bookshop forever.
She lost the money she saved.

preguntas.retro: Empezó a recomendar libros (más confianza) y descubrió que quiere estudiar literatura.

preguntas.enunciado: What did Sara buy with the money she saved?
preguntas.retro: «She had saved enough money to buy a new laptop for university».

preguntas.enunciado: What is the best title for the text?

opciones.texto: How a summer job changed Sara's plans

preguntas.retro: El texto cuenta cómo el trabajo de verano influyó en lo que Sara quiere estudiar.
